'''Clue scroll (medium)''' is an [[emote clue]] obtained from [[Clue scroll (medium)|medium]] [[Treasure Trails]].

This clue step cannot be given to [[Ironman Mode]] players.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1121328142336110592|date=25 April 2019|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/100826|archivedate=30 May 2020|quote=Interestingly, yes, that one is blocked for Iron players.
